name: Facebook Ads Conversions
shortInfo: Leverage offline conversion data from your data warehouse to the Facebooks Ads platform
brief: This sync enables moving offline conversion data from a user specified data warehouse to the Facebooks Ads platform
about:
The Facebook Ads Reverse ETL Sync enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Facebook Ads platform in an automated manner.  
  
Learn more about [Facebook Ads Conversions.](https://en-gb.facebook.com/business/learn/facebook-create-ad-website-conversions)
availableSync:
[Offline Conversions](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/facebookads/syncs/offline_conversions.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve offline conversion data from a user specified data warehouse to the Facebooks Ads platform.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/facebookads/index.html) here.
